opus.problem: The cited verse (Esther 2:7) does not mention Susa. That setting comes from Esther 2:5, so the clue is not fully supported by its own reference.
The cited verse (Esther 2:22) does not say the plot was by two eunuchs or that it was an assassination attempt. Those details come from Esther 2:21, so the reference should cover 2:21-22.
Being taken into the king's harem comes from Esther 2:8, not the cited Esther 2:10. Only the secrecy part is supported by the given verse.
